name: Ring of Darkness, Improved
body:
Aura moderate transmutation ; CL 10th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears and functions as a ring of shadows, improved. Upon putting on the ring, the wearer becomes vulnerable to light, suffering 1d2 points of damage every round spent in light brighter than dim light. Damage from light-based attacks against the wearer is increased by 50%.

All attack, damage and skill check rolls made by the wearer are made at a -4 penalty when in light brighter than dim light and at a -2 penalty when in dim light conditions.

This ring can be removed by casting continual flame followed by remove curse upon it, destroying the ring in the process.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of shadows, improved

Identification DC 35
False Identification DC 25
